import importlib.util
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
root = Path(r'C:\Users\stop-\n1-kanji-workspace\scratch-127\review')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
suite = unittest.TestSuite()
for name in ('test-guarded-test-v3', 'test-review-chain', 'test-report-structure', 'test-review-audit'):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name.replace('-', '_'), root / (name + '.py'))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    cases = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromModule(module)
    assert cases.countTestCases() > 0, name
    suite.addTests(cases)
assert suite.countTestCases() == 81, suite.countTestCases()
print('Explicitly loaded', suite.countTestCases(), 'tests', flush=True)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=1).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)
